The airport forecast (TAF) shows heavy thunderstorms during 11/10 19:00–11/11 01:00 and 11/11 07:00–19:00 with visibility of 2500 m and gusts of 28 to 30 kt, reaching the Medium threshold. Although the model voting results are Low across all periods, the US model forecasts 46.1 mm of rain in 6 hours for 11/12 19:00–11/13 01:00, which alone reaches the Medium threshold.
